sentences.text: The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

T he applicant has been arrested by Police Station Gyaraspur, District Vidisha (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 243 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 344, 376,
and 376(2) (n) of IPC and Sections 5 and 6 of POCSO Act.
Allegation against the present applicant is that he abducted the prosecutrix and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
Allegedly, the incident occurred on 18.11.2022, however, the FIR has been lodged on 22.11.2022 after a gap of almost 4 days, for which, no plausible explanation has been given.

It is further argued that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.

1 specifically stated that she got married with the present applicant and wants to live with him.

sentences.text:
It is further argued that the prosecutrix travelled with the present applicant in public transport, however,
there is no evidence on record to show that she resisted or raised any alarm to save her.
Further argument is that the applicant is in custody since 21.01.2023.

After completion of investigation,
charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.
Applicant is the permanent resident of Village Devsiraliya Police Station Kanaud, District Dewas (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
O n the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
